card.name: The word twice in frequency and comparisons
card.fires_on: The word "twice" (and once the end of "sixteenth"), mainly in dosing frequency like "twice daily" and in comparisons like "twice as much".

modes.label: Dosing frequency
modes.description: "twice" gives how often something is taken or checked, before daily, weekly or a day.
